title: Meta introduces specialized versions of its existing models, trained using Muse Wonder, bringing Active Memory and Active Focus to all Muse and Meta AI users (Frederic Lardinois/The New Stack)
summary: Frederic Lardinois / The New Stack: Meta introduces specialized versions of its existing models, trained using Muse Wonder, bringing Active Memory and Active Focus to all Muse and Meta AI users — Starting on Friday, everyone using Meta's Muse agent and Meta AI gets new models the company trained using Muse Wonder, its frontier model.
